et_patrol: I walk the east road for the Deathguard. The fog's thick through these woods, and the Scarlet Crusade likes it that way - their watch post is to the north, their monastery beyond it.
et_scarlet_watch_scout: Hollowmere, scout. The Crusade's watch post is just north-east of here, and they have archers along the coast behind it. They think burning us twice makes it stick. They're welcome to try again.
et_deathguard_linnea: Deathguard Linnea, at the zeppelin landing. Passengers to the left, ropes to the right. The Ruins of Lordaeron are just south of us, and the dead walking out of them don't know the war's over - or that they lost it.
et_gravekeeper_morvyn: Morvyn. I keep the graves at Faol's Rest, just north of here. They used to stay in them. Something's been breaking the seals, and what comes up comes up angry.
et_gunther_lorn: Warden Gunther Lorn. I watch Brightwater Lake, north-west of this post. The drowned come out of it at dusk, and there's a cold at the middle of it that wasn't there last year.
et_scout_hallam: Hallam, scout. Keep low. The Crusader's Outpost is just north-east of us and they've got archers on the wall. They're taking recruits faster than I can count them.
et_hunter_ravel: Ravel. I hunt Venomweb Vale - you're standing at the edge of it. Spiders the size of ponies and a mother somewhere in the middle. The Apothecaries pay for the venom. Mind your step.
et_balnir_edric: Edric. I was stablehand at Balnir Farmstead - that's it, just south-east. The horses are gone. Worgs sleep in the paddock, and the stableboys I worked with are still doing their rounds.
et_cult_warden: Warden Ysolde Grave. I was posted to watch the farm east of here. It belongs to the Cult of the Damned now. I came to watch. These days I count - acolytes in, carts in, nothing out.
et_cave_warden: Boneward Calder. There's a hole behind the cult's farm, just north-west of where I'm standing, and it goes down into a Scourge warren. It breathes. Don't tell me it doesn't.
